translations.english: The family priest (Vasistha) and other brahmins were the first to board. Next mighty Bharata and Satrughna, Kausalya, Sumitra, women of the palace including the other wives of the king and wagons and supplies followed.
translations.hindi: खियाँ उच्चस्वर से रोते रोते थक कर-अब चुप हो गई होंगी आर अब राजभवन में सन्नाटा छाया होगा
